description: Debloat and harden Brave Browser using Chromium enterprise policies
pre_install:
@'
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
script = fso.BuildPath(fso.GetParentFolderName(WScript.ScriptFullName), "SlimBrave.ps1")
shell.Run "powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File """ & script & """", 0, False
'@ | Set-Content -Path "$dir\SlimBrave.vbs" -Encoding ASCII
